text:
nora: Quick flag from onboarding: Jade v0.6-int6 failing locale-mix-v2 smoke. Mixed zh+ar case shows stray ZWJ between Han and Arabic digits, BLEU ~ -3.8 vs fp32.

sam: ugh. repro?

nora: payload: { src: "今天: ١٢٣", lang: "zh-ar_mixed" } staging returned:
"今天‍١٢٣" (ZWJ U+200D between han and arabic digits). fp32 fine.

akiko: token dump from int6: ["\u4eca\u5929", "\u0001", "\u0661", "\u0662", "\u0663"] — there's a placeholder token 0x01 in middle.
sam: placeholder likely from vocab shrink in qpack step; runtime fast-joiner treats placeholder as soft-join and inserts ZWJ.

akiko: checked qpack: shrink_map maps unknown sequences to 0x01 when remapping rare grams for int6. fp32 doesn't use shrink_map. The joiner logic should ignore placeholder ids.
nora: can we patch quickly on staging?

ops-bot: CI patch branch created: fix/jade-int6-ignore-placeholder by akiko.

sam: will add guard: if token_id in PLACEHOLDER_SET skip fast-joiner mirror/zwj insertion. Also adding unit test mixing CJK+Arabic digits.

deploy-bot: patch queued to staging. ETA ~9m.
akiko: patched and re-ran smoke locally: token dump now ["\u4eca\u5929", "\u0661", "\u0662", "\u0663"] and output no ZWJ. BLEU delta -0.05 vs fp32.
nora: great. follow-ups: add test to locale-mix-suite, update model-onboard.md note about shrink_map semantics, and review other quant profiles for same placeholder behavior.
sam: will grep other qpack configs and add automated check in onboarding harness.
nora: leaving thread open until nightly green. thanks.
